welcome.title: Welcome to TEN10
welcome.description: We'll show you how to get started in less than a minute.
welcome.skip: I'll look around on my own

tour.dateRangeDescription: This month, this year, all time, or a custom range. The cards follow what you choose.
tour.titheBalanceDescription: Positive means you still owe. Negative means you have given more than required — a credit.
tour.openingBalanceDescription: Coming from another notebook or spreadsheet? Set the current balance once here. TEN10 continues from that number. Use the + on this card.
tour.cardQuickAddDescription: Each + opens a transaction of that type — income, expense, or donation. Click the income + to continue.
tour.flagsDescription: On income: Chomesh (20%) or exempt. On expense: from maaser or from chomesh. You can also enter another currency in the amount field.
tour.recurringDescription: Turn this on for a salary, rent, or a fixed donation. TEN10 will create the next occurrences for you.
tour.liveBalanceDescription: These cards move as you type and after you save. Fill in the amount and save when you are ready.

success.title: You're in
success.description: Your first transaction is saved. The monthly chart below Home shows the trend, and Contact is there if you need a rabbi or technical help.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.description: Two small steps to see TEN10 at work.
